summary:
Completed Phase 4 for currency-service. Added the shared-preset `renovate.json`, trusted-main weekly dependency-submission workflow with basic caching and separate package/submission credentials, repository dependency-automation documentation with durable Phase 12 handoff, and README documentation link. No dependencies or service logic changed.

Validation passed: Node 24/npm prerequisite, strict Renovate configuration validation, actionlint, link and diff checks. Extraction found 57 occurrences across Gradle, wrapper, Dockerfile, and Actions managers, including all three `org.budgetanalyzer` coordinates. Credential-free lookup returned 45 public candidate branches; the initial transient Docker socket failure cleared on retry. The sole remaining diagnostic requires GitHub authentication and is deferred.

The inspected local snapshot contains 87 build/tool coordinates and no internal or application runtime/test dependencies because `serviceCommon` 0.0.16 requires authenticated remote resolution. Published-preset resolution, authenticated Renovate lookups, complete hosted graph submission, bot-PR CI, and Dependabot alert evidence remain pending Phase 12 as documented in `docs/dependency-automation.md`.
